place.summary: Monster Building functions primarily as a connector in Hong Kong's visitor network. Its strongest observed source market is JP. It receives notable inbound connections from Hong Kong Disneyland. Visitors often continue to Hong Kong International Airport. Its observed experience trails the category average, despite existing visitor demand.
